name: Evidence-state milestone strip
reader_question: Which milestones have actually been evidenced, and which remain announced or targeted?
relationship: One dated sequence of milestones; marker style encodes each milestone's evidence state (announced, targeted, reported, independently verified).
use_when: A single project or programme has milestones whose evidence quality differs
A reader should not mistake a target or announcement for an observed outcome
avoid_when: Stages of a formal process are the point — use stage-ladder
Several actors have parallel schedules — use swimlane

data_contract.notes: Ascending order; for targeted milestones the target date

units: Calendar dates on a linear day-count scale spanning whole calendar years.

editable: Markers, stems, spine and labels as native shapes and text boxes
not_data_bound: Dates are positioned from the fixture at build time; changing a state means restyling its marker by hand

table_alternative: A milestone table (date, milestone, evidence state, source) for audit-grade lookup.
variations: Per-milestone source tag under the date
limitations: The accent marks at most one independently verified milestone; more would break the single-highlight rule
Evidence state describes the milestone's support, not its importance or whether the target was met

excluded_alternatives.reason: Milestones are points; bars would imply durations that are not stated
Colour grading implies a performance judgement rather than the quality of evidence
